tips.text: Put a server's token in the vault, then name the item with `--env VAR=item`. A value never goes on the command line.
tips.command: vyre connect add mcp harlow-docs --env DOCS_TOKEN=harlow-docs -- <command>

tips.text: `vyre connect list` shows every connection, and `vyre connect test mcp harlow-docs` tries one now.
A tool that writes or sends is held at the Gate. Claude gets the held item back and waits for your approval.
Add `--project harlow-legal` to `vyre connect add mcp` to keep a server to one client. The default is every project.
After Test in the Deck, set each tool to Read, Held or Off. A tool whose name sends can never be Read.
Add Vyre's tools to a claude you start yourself: `vyre mcp install` prints the line, and runs it with `--yes`.
Hub tools reach Claude as `<server>__<tool>`, so no server needs its own line in a Claude config.
A server starts on first use and stops after 10 minutes idle. Three crashes in five minutes keep it stopped.
`vyre connect remove mcp harlow-docs` disconnects a server and leaves its vault items where they are.
